test_cases.system_response: System provided helpful error message: 'I'm sorry, but "99999" is not a valid FIPS code for a US county. Please provide a valid 5-digit FIPS code (e.g., "29077" for Greene County, MO). If you don't know the FIPS code, please provide the county and state name.'
test_cases.robustness_observation: Excellent validation and user guidance - clear error message with example and alternative approach

test_cases.system_response: System asked for clarification about what type of weather history is needed, treating 29078 as a valid FIPS without validation error.

test_cases.modification_description: Query with special characters and noise
test_cases.system_response: System extracted FIPS 29077 from noisy input and asked for clarification on type of weather history needed, providing options for severe weather, drought, flood, and climate trends.
test_cases.robustness_observation: Excellent input sanitization - system successfully parsed meaningful data from noisy input

strengths: Strong FIPS code validation with helpful error messages
Effective scope management to prevent resource exhaustion
Good input sanitization - extracts meaningful data from noisy input
Graceful degradation with clarification requests for minimal queries
Prioritizes structured data (FIPS) over potentially misspelled text
Provides actionable alternatives when requests cannot be fulfilled
weaknesses: Complete failure on extremely vague queries without clarification attempt
No FIPS existence validation (only format validation)
Zero event results not flagged as potential system issue in baseline test
recommendations: Add fallback clarification prompt for vague queries instead of failing
Implement FIPS code existence validation against known county database
Add anomaly detection for improbable query results (e.g., 0 events)
Consider adding query complexity scoring to proactively guide users
